sections.heading: Auckland CBD Gyms
sections.body: The Auckland CBD has a high concentration of gyms, including City Fitness, Les Mills, and Jetts. These gyms offer convenient locations for those working in the city, with prices starting from $25 per week.

sections.heading: Gyms in Auckland Suburbs
sections.body: Auckland's suburbs have a range of gym options, including franchise locations like Anytime Fitness and Jetts. Prices vary depending on the location and amenities, but expect to pay between $20 and $40 per week.
